'''Paul Kellam''' (born 1965) is a Professor of Viral Genomics at [[Imperial College London]] and vice-president of infectious diseases and vaccines at Kymab Ltd. He is co-author of the Oxford textbook ''Human Virology''.

==Education==
Kellam attended [[Oakwood Park Grammar School]]. He received a Bachelor Science in [[Microbiology]] from the [[University of Reading]] in 1987 and a PhD in [[Virology]] from the [[University of London]] in 1994.

==Advisory panels==
As of 2021, Professor Kellam sits on the PHE Serology Working Group as a member of the [[Scientific Advisory Group for Emergencies]] in response to [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom|COVID-19]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=List of participants of SAGE and related sub-groups|url=https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/scientific-advisory-group-for-emergencies-sage-coronavirus-covid-19-response-membership/list-of-participants-of-sage-and-related-sub-groups|access-date=2021-07-30|website=GOV.UK|language=en}}</ref>

Kellam is chair of the [[Microbiology Society]] Policy Committee.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://microbiologysociety.org/why-microbiology-matters/council-governance/committees/policy-committee.html |title=Policy Committee {{!}} Microbiology Society |website=microbiologysociety.org |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200926073306/https://microbiologysociety.org/why-microbiology-matters/council-governance/committees/policy-committee.html |archive-date=2020-09-26}}</ref>

==Awards and honours==
He was elected a Fellow of the American Academy of Microbiology, [[American Society for Microbiology]], July 2015<ref>{{cite web|title=Paul Kellam|url=http://academy.asm.org/index.php/fellows-info/aam-fellows-elected-in-2015/5361-paul-kellam|website=academy.asm.org|access-date=2016-04-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160514125713/http://academy.asm.org/index.php/fellows-info/aam-fellows-elected-in-2015/5361-paul-kellam|archive-date=2016-05-14|url-status=dead}}</ref> and [[Fellow of the Academy of Medical Sciences]] in 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-05-21 |title=Academy of Medical Sciences announces new Fellows for 2026 |url=https://acmedsci.ac.uk/more/news/academy-new-fellows-2026 |access-date=2026-05-22 |website=Academy of Medical Sciences}}</ref>
